summary: Measure mission, work and attention collection snapshots on the existing daemon_load subscribers

replay.detail: Test workload only; production graph replay and startup are unchanged.

schema.detail: No production or checkpoint schema changes; generated load fixture schema is unchanged.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules, admission policy, writer behavior or fleet coordination changes.

compatibility.detail: No client protocol changes. Load report JSON gains optional per-collection counts; legacy reports deserialize with empty counts.

downtime.detail: No serving code changes or deployment restart required by this measurement change.

manual.detail: Run the existing opt-in release daemon_load command to measure all four held collections. Subsequent view changes compare against the expanded workload baseline.

recovery.detail: Reverting the test change restores the roster-only workload; no production database state changes.
